provenance.historicalRuntimeNotes: v32.4 runtime used audioHighConf .62, audioMidConf .34, slipThreshold .18 and speedRpmMinKmh 12. Phone Smart Tracker used .5/1/2 branches, continuity, GPS assist and jump protection. Adaptive replay trained 500-rpm bands from GPS-master and audio candidates using .5/1/2 corrections.
provenance.important: This frozen v1 reproduces the high-performing offline harmonic-oracle comparison previously used in analysis. It does not claim to reproduce live phone_rpm_smart.js frame-by-frame because original PCM/FFT frames are not present in this ZIP. The historical runtime source is separately preserved and must remain available for exact live-method reconstruction when suitable PCM/spectrum data exists.
